svg.text: Assembly only. Up to 6 scanned neighbour genes per side in core orientation, coloured by homology group; red dashed outline = mobile-like neighbour skipped for host context. Element estimate = coding span + shared flank with different-context copies (not an insertion call).
A = cross-assembly host-different, B = within-assembly only, C = nested / adjacent mobile (near different, host similar), D = two-gene core. Hover a gene for its product.
